name: devops-autopilot
description: Transforms Antigravity into a DevOps engineer. Writes production-grade Dockerfiles and docker-compose files, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform/Pulumi infrastructure-as-code, and sets up monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana. From code to production without a separate DevOps team.
suggestedPrompts: Write a production-ready multi-stage Dockerfile and docker-compose for my project with health checks and security hardening
Create Kubernetes manifests (Deployment, Service, Ingress, HPA) for my application with resource limits
Set up Terraform infrastructure for my app on AWS/GCP with VPC, managed database, and auto-scaling
